items.title: Novo Nordisk (CPSE:NOVO B) Sees New Pressure In Weight Loss Drugs
items.summary: Novo Nordisk (CPSE:NOVO B) faces fresh competition as the UK's MHRA approves Eli Lilly's oral weight loss therapy Foundayo for use in the country. The approval adds a non injectable option alongside Novo Nordisk's GLP 1 based obesity drugs and could affect demand patterns if Foundayo is adopted in public healthcare settings.
